name: Jigen Daishi
original_name: 慈眼 大師 (ジゲン ダイシ)
source:
An Outsider who washed up on the shores of Tenguu Island, the leader of the Red.
He is a hero who saved the people of the Red with his knowledge from another world, who were shunned because of their cursed blood.
He is the only person who knew [url=/c74516]Tokisada[/url] before.

[spoiler]He is [url=/c74513]Akaza[/url]'s father. In "Catharsis" he keeps a watchful eye over the island's developments in order to ensure that Akaza succeeds him as leader of the Red.
